title: Chapter 710
text:
Introduction: In the Age of Chaos, spiritual energy was exhausted. Cultivators had no way to make a living, so they degenerated into demons and fed on humans. At this time, a man with so much spiritual energy leaking out from his side naturally became the meat of Tang Seng that everyone wanted to eat. Not only did they want to eat him, some female demons even wanted to … This is a story about how one finally became a god by relying on coquettish manipulation!
